input_route.meaning: Recorded P1 input sequence used as the ROM-stepper route; runtime must bind this exact identity.

source_model.name: ROM-only 6502/PPU/DMC source stepper
source_model.time_quantization: Events are applied in source-frame order. Sub-frame cycles are preserved for audit but not used by the Godot helper.

a117.source: bank $02 $A117-$A128, reached via $C76E->$C421->$A000 when $001B bit 6 is set

c9c5.source_operands_layout: [frame, commit_cycle, E1_before, E2_before, E3_before, incoming_carry, X0300, address0300, value0300, X0700, address0700, value0700, X0780, address0780, value0780, E1_after, E2_after, E3_after]
c9c5.limitation: Operands and results are ROM-stepper-derived for this fingerprinted input route. The rows are not a generic substitute for live operand writers under arbitrary input histories.
c9c5.source_operands_cycle_basis: commit_cycle is the source-stepper CPU cycle at the $C9E5 E1 store; the diagnostic read trace separately records each operand-read cycle.

receiver_selection.formula: i=E2&7; if i>=5 then i-=5; slot=table[i]+$05FB; current match base $05FB is zero
